net.canarymod.database

Annotation Type Column


  • @Retention(value=RUNTIME)
@Target(value=FIELD)
public @interface Column
    Marks a field of a DataAccess object as a column in a database table. This annotation also describes the column so that it will be handled properly in the database
    Author:
    Chris (damagefilter)
